# pilot

> A reactive PR inbox in your terminal: GitHub (and Linear) events flow to you as workspaces — a git worktree plus an embedded Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / shell session per task.

## Docs

- [Home](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/): What pilot is, who it's for, and a map of the documentation.
- [Tutorials](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/tutorials/): Learning-oriented lessons for newcomers.
- [Quickstart](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/tutorials/quickstart/): Build from source and open your first workspace with a live terminal in ~5 minutes.
- [How-to guides](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/how-to/): Task-oriented recipes.
- [Add a repo](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/how-to/add-a-repo/): Bring a repository's PRs and issues into the inbox and filter by role.
- [Run an agent per workspace](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/how-to/run-an-agent-per-workspace/): Spawn Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor scoped to one worktree.
- [Per-repo env and mounts](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/how-to/per-repo-env-and-mounts/): Inject env vars, symlink shared dirs, materialize scripts.
- [Remote over SSH](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/how-to/remote-over-ssh/): Run the daemon remotely and the TUI locally over a forwarded socket.
- [Mirror to Slack](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/how-to/mirror-to-slack/): Reflect the inbox into Slack channels.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/reference/cli/): Every pilot subcommand, flag, and run mode.
- [Keybindings](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/reference/keybindings/): The full keymap for every pane and picker.
- [Configuration](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/reference/configuration/): The complete ~/.pilot/config.yaml schema with an annotated example.

## Explanation

- [Mental model](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/explanation/mental-model/): Workspace = worktree + agent, the reactive inbox, read/unread, and the isolation rationale.
- [Architecture](https://antoinetoussaint.github.io/pilot/explanation/architecture/): Client/daemon split, the crates, the event bus, the credential chain, and the embedded terminal.
